title: Refine cursor behaviour across inputs and pages
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Keep the active control predictable as views and input devices change.

**Expected behaviour** · Define entry and return targets for Connect, Home, overview, reader, menus and Settings. Release invalid targets after busy states, scroll and resize.

**Scope boundary** · Cover stylus hover/contact and touch scrolling. Controller readiness follows keyboard focus rules.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-037

**Depends on** · WI-030, WI-033, WI-035, WI-037

**Verify** · Replay modality changes, menu dismissal and route restoration. Distinguish physical device results from emulated input and record unavailable hardware.

**Effort basis** · Device variability and focus timing.
evidence: Pointer targets the actionable bounds for folder, app card, icon button, Run and menu items; keyboard takes over from a parked pointer; the brackets lock to the card during the turn; menu Escape returns to its trigger; transforms only, so no layout shift. Physical pen, controller and touch hardware were unavailable and are recorded as a gap. Evidence: qa/sprint-4/WI-038/.
